skill.summary: Auto-generates a CLI reference doc so your agent stops guessing OpenClaw commands and starts working. Discovers all commands, subcommands, and flags from you...

latestVersion.changelog: Patch: enrichment phase now filters mid-sentence HTML fragments and incomplete-thought captures (no more comma/colon-led noise lines). Added curl --connect-timeout 5 / --max-time 15 so the wizard can't hang on a flaky doc server.
